design.unit: ticker x trading day with >=1 relevant headline; sentiment = mean P(pos)-P(neg)
design.abnormal_return: stock return minus QQQ return (market-adjusted model)
design.abnormal_volume: log volume minus mean log volume over the previous 20 trading days
design.timing: FNSPID dates have no times; weekend/holiday news is assigned to the next trading day
design.inference: bootstrap clustered by event date, 500 resamples
design.not_advice: Association study on historical data; not a trading signal or investment advice.
